answer: Tradies use AI to answer calls when they can’t, text back missed callers, collect job details and photos, draft quotes from their price list, book jobs into their scheduling software, send reminders and follow up quotes and reviews. The tradie stays in control of pricing and the work itself.
body:
Every missed call is a missed job

When you’re up a ladder, under a house or driving between jobs, you can’t answer the phone. Homeowners with an urgent problem call the next business on the list. Quotes sit unsent because there’s no time after a long day, and follow-ups never happen.

AI works like an office manager who never takes a day off: it answers, books, quotes and follows up, and you get a summary when you’re back in the ute.

Where AI helps tradies most

Answering calls on the job

An AI receptionist answers in your business name, works out what the customer needs, and books a time or takes details. Emergencies are flagged to your mobile immediately. See AI receptionist.

Missed-call text-back

If a call is missed, the customer receives a text within seconds offering help, and the conversation continues by SMS. See AI workflow automation.

Job details and quoting

AI collects job details, photos and address, then drafts a quote from your price list and past jobs for your one-tap approval. See custom AI agents.

Quote and review follow-up

Sent quotes are followed up automatically, and completed jobs trigger a review request a day later. See AI voice agent.

Scheduling and reminders

Bookings go straight into your job software, with reminder texts sent to customers before you arrive. See CRM automation.

Human-backed AI employees for tradies

Most tradies don’t want another tool to supervise. Our AI Employees service builds the AI around your business, then runs it with a dedicated Crenosoft team that learns your services, clients and rules. The AI handles routine work; our reviewers handle anything unusual, around the clock; and decisions that belong to you come to your nominated person with a clear summary. We agree an hours-saved target up front and report against it every month.

Software we connect to

We connect to trades software such as ServiceM8, simPRO, Tradify, Fergus and AroFlo where integrations are available, plus Google Calendar, SMS, Xero and MYOB, and your existing business phone number.

Fair quotes and clear customer communication

AI never invents prices: quotes are drafted from your price list and approved by you before they are sent. Customers are told they are speaking with an AI assistant, and urgent safety issues such as gas leaks or electrical hazards are always directed to you or emergency services. Messages stay consistent with Australian Consumer Law obligations, which the ACCC explains for small businesses.

Across every project we follow the Privacy Act 1988, the OAIC’s guidance on commercially available AI products and our own Responsible AI Policy.

A day on the tools with AI

You start a hot water system replacement at 8am. While you work, the AI answers four calls: two bookings for next week, one quote request with photos, and an urgent leak it flags straight to your phone. At lunch you approve two drafted quotes with a tap. By the time you pack up, yesterday’s quotes have been followed up, last week’s customers have been asked for reviews, and tomorrow’s customers have their reminder texts.

Results we measure for trades businesses

Before we build, we record a baseline of how long the work takes and how often it happens. After launch, your monthly report tracks the numbers that matter to trades businesses:

  • Calls answered and jobs booked by the AI
  • Missed calls recovered through text-back
  • Time from enquiry to quote sent
  • Quotes followed up and accepted
  • Reviews requested and received

These figures sit alongside hours saved and accuracy, so you can see exactly what the AI is contributing and where our team is still stepping in.

You decide what the AI can promise, from call-out fees to booking windows, and it sticks to those rules on every call.

How to get started

  1. Free AI audit: 30 minutes to map your busiest workflows and pick the first opportunity.
  2. Blueprint and fixed quote: what the AI will do, which systems it connects to and the price in AUD.
  3. Build and test: usually two to six weeks, tested on real examples from your business.
  4. Launch and improve: monthly reports on hours saved, accuracy and improvements.

Not sure where to begin? Start with an AI Readiness Assessment, or see how we work locally on our Melbourne AI agency page.
faqs: Can AI answer my mobile while I’m working?
Yes. Calls can forward to the AI receptionist when you don’t pick up, or all the time. It books jobs, takes details and texts you a summary.
Only prices you approve. AI drafts quotes from your price list for you to check, and can share standard call-out fees if you choose.
Does it work with ServiceM8 or simPRO?
In most cases, yes. We connect to trades software that offers integrations, so jobs and customer details flow straight in.
What does it cost for a small trades business?
We quote a fixed set-up fee and a monthly fee in AUD after a free audit, based on your call volume and the systems involved.
